data.gender_notes: Ayano is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ayano is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ayana', which means 'joy' or 'radiance'. In Hindu mythology, Ayana is the name of a celestial nymph, symbolizing happiness, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Ayano carries the meaning “Joy, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayano usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayano belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayano total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
